title: Benchmark results file
description: Measured benchmark results for one model artifact, ingested by `edge-card build --bench`. Public, versioned API: stable names, no breaking renames after commit. This toolkit never executes benchmarks — every record is owner-measured data, and every record carries `provenance`. The record shape is designed as a field superset of the frozen litert-community perf-table columns (Device / Variant / stage latencies / derived metrics / harness footnote), and existing exports (devicemark leaderboard JSONL, bench-harness exports, gpu_audit outputs) map onto it via adapters in `src/litert_compat/cards/adapters/` — first-class fields for the common columns, the open `metrics` map for harness-specific ones.

model_id.description: Must match the card's model.id; `edge-card build` refuses a mismatch.

runtime.description: Runtime identity for comparative rows (e.g. a card's cross_runtime list, which requires it). Absent/null means the native LiteRT runtime.

metrics.description: Harness-specific metrics beyond the first-class fields, e.g. stage latencies (encode_ms, decode_ms, window_total_ms), derived ratios (rtf), LLM metrics (prefill_tok_s, ttft_s), power_w. Keys are snake_case with the unit suffixed where applicable.

runs.description: Number of measured runs behind `statistic` (warmup excluded).

statistic.description: How multiple runs were aggregated, e.g. 'median', 'mean', 'p50'.
